name: off-note-publication-symlinks-modes-failure
description: official-host.ts:1457 'note publication retains symlinks/modes, serializes write+append, and propagates failure'. Notes written through a symlink keep the link and the target's 0640 mode (write then append on the alias gives 'new\ntail\n'), a dangling link creates its target, a 250-char file name works, and a later failing write to a directory fails the batch so the new_context in it does not commit; no *.tmp file remains. (The session file is not captured and tool_execution_end is not captured: the four concurrent note writes complete, and append their posthorse-note-touch entries, in a host-timing order; their results are compared as toolResult messages in call order and the notes files with modes. tool_execution_end is not captured: tools of one batch complete in a host-timing order; results are compared as toolResult messages and the captured files.)
setup: mkdir -p .pi/notes/directory && cd .pi/notes && printf old > target.md && chmod 640 target.md && ln -s target.md alias.md && ln -s new-target.md dangling.md
